# DRL-005: Expand protocol and state-machine contract tests

## Metadata

- Milestone: M1
- Labels: `protocol`, `test`
- Owning mission: 02 Architecture / Protocol
- Evidence owner: Architecture/Protocol
- Requirement IDs: `DRL-SYS-001`, `DRL-SYS-005`, `DRL-SYS-007`, `DRL-SEC-001`
- Dependencies: DRL-004
- Public contract impact: COMPATIBLE (tests + possibly internal helpers only)

## User / research value

Illegal state transitions, missing denials, and vague “success” claims cannot pass CI. Later Atticus work stands on contracts, not demos.

## Controlling documents

- `docs/02-architecture/DRL_PROTOCOL.md` (and schemas/)
- `packages/drl-protocol/`
- `services/atticus-control-plane/`
- `agents/02_ARCHITECTURE_PROTOCOL.md`

## Scope

### In scope

- Success path coverage for the fixture workflow
- Policy denial path
- Invalid input rejection
- Cancellation / terminal-state legality
- Property or table tests for transitions where practical

### Out of scope

- Real model providers (DRL-007)
- Specialist public adapters (M3)
- Breaking schema changes without ADR

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tests exist for success, denial, invalid input, cancellation, terminal states
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q` green
- [ ] Foundation validator still passes
- [ ] Gaps vs schema are filed, not ignored

## Verification plan

```bash
uv run pytest -q tests/test_atticus_foundation.py tests/test_foundation.py
uv run python scripts/validate_foundation.py
uv run --package atticus-control-plane atticus-demo --public
```

## Security / privacy / licensing / cost

Negative authorization tests required. No new network egress. Cost: CI minutes.

## Rollback

Revert test/helper PR; keep failing reproduction on a branch if needed.

## Evidence required for closure

pytest output, list of new test names, any ADR if contracts changed.
